decisions.statement: A window here is drawn by the game rather than by the browser.
Where a window is kept is the caller's concern rather than this package's.
Dragging the handle moves the whole window.
A window is clamped to the screen so no drag puts the window out of reach.
The position is handed to the caller each time a drag ends.
A window with no saved position falls back to the caller's default anchor.
A saved position is anchored from the top left of the game's root.

definition: a game window the player drags by a handle, kept where the player left it
